g.text: # sudo asks for a password, which never reaches the recording
$ sudo -k whoami && read -p "Your name: " name && e
$ sudo -k whoami && read -p "Your name: " name && ec
$ sudo -k whoami && read -p "Your name: " name && ech
$ sudo -k whoami && read -p "Your name: " name && echo
$ sudo -k whoami && read -p "Your name: " name && echo "
$ sudo -k whoami && read -p "Your name: " name && echo "H
$ sudo -k whoami && read -p "Your name: " name && echo "He
$ sudo -k whoami && read -p "Your name: " name && echo "Hel
$ sudo -k whoami && read -p "Your name: " name && echo "Hell
$ sudo -k whoami && read -p "Your name: " name && echo "Hello
$ sudo -k whoami && read -p "Your name: " name && echo "Hello,
$ sudo -k whoami && read -p "Your name: " name && echo "Hello, $
$ sudo -k whoami && read -p "Your name: " name && echo "Hello, $n
$ sudo -k whoami && read -p "Your name: " name && echo "Hello, $na
$ sudo -k whoami && read -p "Your name: " name && echo "Hello, $nam
$ sudo -k whoami && read -p "Your name: " name && echo "Hello, $name
$ sudo -k whoami && read -p "Your name: " name && echo "Hello, $name!
$ sudo -k whoami && read -p "Your name: " name && echo "Hello, $name!"
